title: 福爾柯克水輪~Falkirk Wheel
focus: 旋轉升船的浮力平衡、齒輪定向與循環能量~Buoyant balance, geared orientation and cycle energy in a rotating boat lift
summary: 本課以福爾柯克水輪為入口，深入旋轉升船的浮力平衡、齒輪定向與循環能量。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。~Using Falkirk Wheel as its entry point, this course examines buoyant balance, geared orientation and cycle energy in a rotating boat lift. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
example: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 水位差敏感度固定槽面積200 m²、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及水平力臂12 m，只將單槽多出的水深0.02 m減為0.01 m。Δm=ρAΔh由4 t降至2 t，重力轉矩ρAΔhgr由470.88降至235.44 kN·m。減半關係只適用此水平姿態的集中質量模型，不代表整圈轉動的實際電能或任意角度轉矩。~This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold gondola area 200 m², ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and horizontal lever arm 12 m fixed, reducing only excess depth from 0.02 m to 0.01 m. Imbalance Δm=ρAΔh falls from 4 t to 2 t and gravity torque ρAΔhgr from 470.88 to 235.44 kN·m. Halving applies to this horizontal concentrated-mass model, not full-rotation electricity use or torque at every angle.
history: 福爾柯克水輪把兩條運河連接成連續航路，以旋轉船槽展示浮力、質量平衡與齒輪定向如何共同降低提升負擔。福爾柯克水輪開放，取代原先運河連接的船閘階梯功能。 水工鋼結構設計指引提供輪臂與接頭分析的比較背景。 機電指引更新供旋轉設備教育參考，並非水輪改建日期。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。~The Falkirk Wheel reconnects two canals and demonstrates how displacement, balanced masses and geared orientation work together in a rotating boat lift. The Falkirk Wheel opens, replacing the former lock-flight connection between the canals. Hydraulic steel-structure guidance provides comparison context for wheel arms and connections. Updated mechanical guidance supports rotating-equipment education, not a wheel reconstruction date. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

units.anchor: 成對船槽質量平衡~Paired gondola mass balance
units.title: 成對船槽質量平衡~Paired gondola mass balance
units.mechanism: 水輪兩端船槽以近似相等總質量降低重力轉矩，浮船排出等重水是關鍵。但船槽水位差、積水和附著物仍會破壞理想對稱。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。~Paired gondolas reduce gravitational torque by maintaining nearly equal total masses, using equal-weight displacement by floating boats. Level differences, retained water and deposits can still break the ideal symmetry. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m. Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設每槽面積200 m²、其中一槽水位多0.02 m，淡水質量差4 t；若水平力臂12 m，最大重力轉矩Δmgr=470.88 kN·m。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume gondola area 200 m² and one level higher by 0.02 m, giving freshwater imbalance 4 t. At horizontal lever arm 12 m, maximum gravity torque Δmgr=470.88 kN·m.
units.verify: 比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。把多餘水量與兩槽質量差放在同一張平衡表。~Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position. Place excess water and the two-gondola mass difference in one balance sheet.
units.failure: 船舶自由浮動不代表船槽水位自動相同，排水路徑受阻時額外水量仍會增加。只看船舶重量而忽略水位，會把真正不平衡原因歸錯對象。~Free flotation does not automatically equalize gondola levels, and obstructed drainage can retain extra water. Looking only at vessel mass while ignoring level misidentifies the source of the gravitational imbalance.
units.misconception: 兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。~With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels.
units.practice: 以成對船槽質量平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較兩槽水位與總重推估，將浮船排水和多餘儲水分開；用正反向轉矩差核對不平衡來源，再檢查最大差值是否出現在水平位置。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for paired gondola mass balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare both levels and inferred mass, separating vessel displacement from excess stored water. Use opposite-direction torque differences to check imbalance and determine whether its maximum occurs near the horizontal position.

units.anchor: 重力轉矩隨角度~Gravity torque versus angle
units.title: 重力轉矩隨角度~Gravity torque versus angle
units.mechanism: 質量差對旋轉軸的力臂隨角度改變，垂直位置重力轉矩可以接近零，水平位置則較大。固定轉矩模型無法描述整個半圈動作。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。~The lever arm of a mass imbalance changes with angle. Gravity torque can approach zero vertically and peak horizontally, so constant torque cannot describe an entire half-turn. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses. Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設質量差3000 kg、半徑12 m、相對水平角60°，τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m；限集中質量與平面剛體。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance 3000 kg, radius 12 m and angle sixty degrees above horizontal. τ=Δmgrcosθ=176.58 kN·m, for planar rigid motion with concentrated masses.
units.verify: 將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。以水平與垂直位置的理論極值檢查角度定義。~Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction. Use theoretical horizontal and vertical extrema to verify the chosen angular reference.
units.failure: 若把角度從垂直量起卻沿用餘弦公式，轉矩峰值位置會錯九十度。傳動摩擦和風力也可能改變曲線，不能把所有殘差當成質量差。~Using an angle measured from vertical in a horizontal-reference cosine shifts the predicted peak by ninety degrees. Friction and wind also alter the curve, so residuals do not uniquely reveal mass imbalance.
units.misconception: 質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。~A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
units.practice: 以重力轉矩隨角度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將實測轉矩扣除慣性項後對轉角作圖，比較餘弦形狀；再以不同旋轉方向辨別摩擦符號，確認角度零點和重力方向一致。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gravity torque versus angle, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot measured torque minus inertia against angle and compare the cosine shape. Use opposite rotation to distinguish friction sign and verify consistent angle zero and gravity direction.

units.anchor: 船槽水平與齒輪定向~Gondola leveling by gearing
units.title: 船槽水平與齒輪定向~Gondola leveling by gearing
units.mechanism: 船槽需要在主輪轉動時保持接近水平，定向機構抵銷支臂相對地面的旋轉。這是運動學約束，不是只靠自由擺動就能保證的結果。 假設主臂轉過180°，船槽對主臂反轉−180°，對地角度和為0°；理想一比一反向定向，不聲稱本站完整齒輪齒數。 齒隙會在換向時形成短暫角度誤差，軸承阻力也可能使自由懸吊無法理想跟隨。只在上下終點檢查水平，可能漏掉中途最大的船槽傾斜。~Gondolas remain approximately horizontal by counteracting the arm rotation relative to the ground. This is a kinematic constraint rather than a result guaranteed solely by free swinging. Assume the main arm rotates 180 degrees and the gondola rotates −180 degrees relative to it. Ground-referenced change is zero, an ideal opposite one-to-one relation rather than actual site tooth counts. Backlash creates brief reversal errors and bearing resistance prevents ideal free following. Checking level only at upper and lower endpoints can miss the largest gondola tilt during intermediate rotation.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設主臂轉過180°，船槽對主臂反轉−180°，對地角度和為0°；理想一比一反向定向，不聲稱本站完整齒輪齒數。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume the main arm rotates 180 degrees and the gondola rotates −180 degrees relative to it. Ground-referenced change is zero, an ideal opposite one-to-one relation rather than actual site tooth counts.
units.verify: 以地面水平基準同時量主臂和船槽角度，檢查兩角和在全行程是否穩定；將齒隙造成的換向偏差和結構撓曲分開繪製。另以獨立傾角計檢查水面與槽體的相對角度。~Measure arm and gondola angles against a ground-level reference and check their sum over the full travel. Plot reversal backlash separately from structural bending instead of combining them into one orientation error. Use an independent inclinometer to compare water-surface orientation with gondola orientation.
units.failure: 齒隙會在換向時形成短暫角度誤差，軸承阻力也可能使自由懸吊無法理想跟隨。只在上下終點檢查水平，可能漏掉中途最大的船槽傾斜。~Backlash creates brief reversal errors and bearing resistance prevents ideal free following. Checking level only at upper and lower endpoints can miss the largest gondola tilt during intermediate rotation.
units.misconception: 只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。~A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
units.practice: 以船槽水平與齒輪定向編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以地面水平基準同時量主臂和船槽角度，檢查兩角和在全行程是否穩定；將齒隙造成的換向偏差和結構撓曲分開繪製。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gondola leveling by gearing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure arm and gondola angles against a ground-level reference and check their sum over the full travel. Plot reversal backlash separately from structural bending instead of combining them into one orientation error.

units.anchor: 旋轉速度與旅程~Rotation speed and travel
units.title: 旋轉速度與旅程~Rotation speed and travel
units.mechanism: 半圈旋轉的平均角速度與最大角速度不同，啟停段必須留出加減速。船槽線速度也隨半徑變化，不能把軸的轉速當成乘客的平移速度。 假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。 將全程平均速度當成處處相同會低估加速段需求，非均勻運轉亦影響水面晃蕩。若半徑取到錯誤位置，換算船槽邊緣速度也會系統性偏差。~Mean half-turn angular speed differs from maximum speed because start and stop need acceleration. Gondola linear speed also depends on radius, so shaft rotation is not passenger translation speed. Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s. Using average speed everywhere misses acceleration demand, while nonuniform movement excites water sloshing. A radius taken to the wrong point also systematically miscalculates speed at the gondola edge.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設半圈轉動歷時300 s、勻速近似，ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s；半徑12 m的速度v=ωr=0.12566 m/s。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a half-turn over 300 s with uniform-speed approximation. ω=π/300=0.010472 rad/s and speed at radius 12 m is v=ωr=0.12566 m/s.
units.verify: 從角位置歷線估算速度並核對線性位移，清楚標記加減速段；比較平均值與峰值，並確認資料濾波沒有把短時速度變化抹去。同時計算不同半徑位置的線速度以檢查換算。~Estimate speed from angle history and verify it against linear travel, marking acceleration intervals. Compare mean and peak values and ensure filtering has not erased brief changes in speed. Calculate linear speeds at several radii to check the geometric conversion independently.
units.failure: 將全程平均速度當成處處相同會低估加速段需求，非均勻運轉亦影響水面晃蕩。若半徑取到錯誤位置，換算船槽邊緣速度也會系統性偏差。~Using average speed everywhere misses acceleration demand, while nonuniform movement excites water sloshing. A radius taken to the wrong point also systematically miscalculates speed at the gondola edge.
units.misconception: 半圈平均角速度就是所有時刻的實際角速度。~Half-turn mean angular speed equals the actual speed at every instant.
units.practice: 以旋轉速度與旅程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從角位置歷線估算速度並核對線性位移，清楚標記加減速段；比較平均值與峰值，並確認資料濾波沒有把短時速度變化抹去。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rotation speed and travel, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Estimate speed from angle history and verify it against linear travel, marking acceleration intervals. Compare mean and peak values and ensure filtering has not erased brief changes in speed.

units.anchor: 轉動慣量與加速~Rotational inertia and acceleration
units.title: 轉動慣量與加速~Rotational inertia and acceleration
units.mechanism: 質量平衡消除部分重力需求，卻不消除轉動慣量。遠離軸心的質量對慣量按半徑平方增加，因此外緣附加設備對啟停需求尤其敏感。 假設兩槽各250000 kg、集中於半徑12 m，I=2mr²=72 million kg·m²；角加速度0.0002 rad/s²需14.4 kN·m，未含輪臂。 把全部質量放在單一半徑只是簡化，輪臂分布和傳動反射慣量可能不可忽略。若用靜態平衡證明馬達能力，便完全漏掉啟停時的動力需求。~Mass balance removes some gravity demand but not rotational inertia. Mass farther from the axis contributes with radius squared, making equipment added near the rim especially important during starting and stopping. Assume two gondolas each 250000 kg concentrated at radius 12 m. I=2mr²=72 million kg·m²; angular acceleration 0.0002 rad/s² requires 14.4 kN·m, excluding wheel arms. A single-radius mass representation is approximate; distributed arms and reflected drivetrain inertia may matter. Static balance alone cannot establish motor capability because it omits starting and stopping demand.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩槽各250000 kg、集中於半徑12 m，I=2mr²=72 million kg·m²；角加速度0.0002 rad/s²需14.4 kN·m，未含輪臂。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume two gondolas each 250000 kg concentrated at radius 12 m. I=2mr²=72 million kg·m²; angular acceleration 0.0002 rad/s² requires 14.4 kN·m, excluding wheel arms.
units.verify: 按實際質量分布建立慣量清單，核對槽、輪臂、傳動與附加設備；以加速段轉矩扣除重力和摩擦後比較，檢查是否遺漏旋轉件。用動能變化率交叉核對加速段的機械功率。~Create an inertia inventory from actual mass distribution, including gondolas, arms, drivetrain and additions. Compare acceleration torque after subtracting gravity and friction, checking for omitted rotating components. Cross-check acceleration-phase mechanical power against the rate of kinetic-energy change.
units.failure: 把全部質量放在單一半徑只是簡化，輪臂分布和傳動反射慣量可能不可忽略。若用靜態平衡證明馬達能力，便完全漏掉啟停時的動力需求。~A single-radius mass representation is approximate; distributed arms and reflected drivetrain inertia may matter. Static balance alone cannot establish motor capability because it omits starting and stopping demand.
units.misconception: 兩端質量完全平衡就代表旋轉慣量等於零。~Perfectly balanced end masses make rotational inertia equal to zero.
units.practice: 以轉動慣量與加速編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按實際質量分布建立慣量清單，核對槽、輪臂、傳動與附加設備；以加速段轉矩扣除重力和摩擦後比較，檢查是否遺漏旋轉件。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rotational inertia and acceleration, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Create an inertia inventory from actual mass distribution, including gondolas, arms, drivetrain and additions. Compare acceleration torque after subtracting gravity and friction, checking for omitted rotating components.

units.anchor: 整循環能量與損失~Full-cycle energy and losses
units.title: 整循環能量與損失~Full-cycle energy and losses
units.mechanism: 理想成對升降可互相交換位能，實際電力主要補足損失和不平衡。整循環比較須包括正負功率與輔助設備，不能用某一瞬間功率乘任意時間。 假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。 忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。宣傳用水壺類比缺乏共同容量時，不能替代電表紀錄。~Ideal paired motion exchanges potential energy, while electricity covers losses and imbalance. A cycle balance includes positive and negative power and auxiliaries rather than multiplying one instantaneous reading by an arbitrary duration. Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s. Total energy is (18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh, not official energy use. Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance. Kettle analogies without common capacity and duration cannot replace metered energy records.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s. Total energy is (18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh, not official energy use.
units.verify: 積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。核對循環起點與終點是否具有相同儲能狀態。~Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Compare cycles at matched levels, weather and vessel conditions rather than ranking values with different energy boundaries. Check that cycle start and finish have equivalent stored-energy states.
units.failure: 忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。宣傳用水壺類比缺乏共同容量時，不能替代電表紀錄。~Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance. Kettle analogies without common capacity and duration cannot replace metered energy records.
units.misconception: 設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。~Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle.
units.practice: 以整循環能量與損失編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-cycle energy and losses, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Compare cycles at matched levels, weather and vessel conditions rather than ranking values with different energy boundaries.

units.anchor: 螺栓預拉與接觸~Bolt pretension and joint contact
units.title: 螺栓預拉與接觸~Bolt pretension and joint contact
units.mechanism: 輪臂連接的螺栓預拉力保持接觸並影響疲勞應力範圍，外力並非全部直接加到螺栓上。接頭剛度決定螺栓與被夾件的載荷分配。 假設單螺栓預拉300 kN、接頭剛度分配係數0.2、外拉力100 kN，未分離時螺栓力320 kN、夾緊力減少80 kN。 表面嵌入和鬆弛可能降低夾緊力而扭矩標記仍在，接頭分離後線性分配失效。若把全部外力忽略或全部加到螺栓，都會誤判疲勞需求。~Pretension maintains contact and affects bolt fatigue range. Applied load does not all go directly into the bolt because relative bolt and clamped-part stiffness controls sharing. Assume bolt pretension 300 kN, stiffness fraction 0.2 and applied tension 100 kN. Before separation bolt force becomes 320 kN and clamping force falls by 80 kN. Embedment and relaxation can reduce clamp force despite intact torque marks, and separation invalidates linear sharing. Either ignoring applied load or adding it entirely to bolts misstates fatigue demand.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單螺栓預拉300 kN、接頭剛度分配係數0.2、外拉力100 kN，未分離時螺栓力320 kN、夾緊力減少80 kN。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume bolt pretension 300 kN, stiffness fraction 0.2 and applied tension 100 kN. Before separation bolt force becomes 320 kN and clamping force falls by 80 kN.
units.verify: 用校準方法核對預拉而非只讀扳手扭矩，查接觸面是否分離或滑移；將外載循環造成的螺栓應變幅與剛度分配模型交叉比較。將預拉損失與表面壓陷量作獨立相關比較。~Verify pretension with a calibrated method rather than torque alone, checking separation and slip. Compare cyclic bolt strain with the predicted stiffness sharing under the applied loading cycle. Independently compare pretension loss with measured embedment of the contact surfaces.
units.failure: 表面嵌入和鬆弛可能降低夾緊力而扭矩標記仍在，接頭分離後線性分配失效。若把全部外力忽略或全部加到螺栓，都會誤判疲勞需求。~Embedment and relaxation can reduce clamp force despite intact torque marks, and separation invalidates linear sharing. Either ignoring applied load or adding it entirely to bolts misstates fatigue demand.
units.misconception: 預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。~All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
units.practice: 以螺栓預拉與接觸編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用校準方法核對預拉而非只讀扳手扭矩，查接觸面是否分離或滑移；將外載循環造成的螺栓應變幅與剛度分配模型交叉比較。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for bolt pretension and joint contact, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Verify pretension with a calibrated method rather than torque alone, checking separation and slip. Compare cyclic bolt strain with the predicted stiffness sharing under the applied loading cycle.

units.anchor: 管形輪臂局部剛度~Tubular-arm section stiffness
units.title: 管形輪臂局部剛度~Tubular-arm section stiffness
units.mechanism: 管形截面把材料移到外側提高彎曲剛度，但薄壁局部屈曲和焊接細節仍可能控制。截面慣性矩只描述整體彎曲，不能取代局部板件分析。 假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。 局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。平均厚度無法代表腐蝕坑或焊趾附近的局部承載，不能只以整體撓度驗收。~Tubular sections place material outward to increase bending stiffness, but local shell buckling and welded details can govern. Section inertia describes overall bending rather than local wall behavior. Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m. I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴, for an intact uniform tube without openings or local thinning. A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. Mean thickness misses pits and local weld-toe demands, so global deflection alone cannot establish local adequacy.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m. I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴, for an intact uniform tube without openings or local thinning.
units.verify: 核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。對最薄壁段另行檢查局部曲率與凹陷深度。~Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Use multiple strains to test linear bending assumptions and inspect local dents separately from overall member curvature. Inspect local curvature and dent depth separately in the thinnest wall regions.
units.failure: 局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。平均厚度無法代表腐蝕坑或焊趾附近的局部承載，不能只以整體撓度驗收。~A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. Mean thickness misses pits and local weld-toe demands, so global deflection alone cannot establish local adequacy.
units.misconception: 管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。~Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling.
units.practice: 以管形輪臂局部剛度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tubular-arm section stiffness, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Use multiple strains to test linear bending assumptions and inspect local dents separately from overall member curvature.

units.anchor: 水面晃蕩時間尺度~Free-surface sloshing time scale
units.title: 水面晃蕩時間尺度~Free-surface sloshing time scale
units.mechanism: 船槽加速度會激起自由液面晃蕩，運動頻率與水深、槽長共同決定反應。小振幅理論可比較尺度，實際船體和隔板會改變流場。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設矩形槽長20 m、水深2 m，k=π/L，ω²=gk tanh(kh)，第一模態T=2π/ω=9.177 s；無船且小振幅。 船體遮擋會分割水面並改變模態，大幅晃蕩與撞壁亦超出線性理論。若只取槽中央測站，可能恰好位於節點而錯認沒有晃蕩。~Gondola acceleration excites free-surface sloshing whose response depends on motion frequency, water depth and tank length. Small-amplitude theory compares scales, while vessels and baffles modify the real flow. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume rectangular tank length 20 m and depth 2 m, with k=π/L and ω²=gk tanh(kh). First-mode T=2π/ω=9.177 s, for small motion without a vessel. A hull subdivides the free surface and changes modes, while large sloshing and wall impact exceed linear theory. A central sensor may sit near a node and falsely suggest no motion.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設矩形槽長20 m、水深2 m，k=π/L，ω²=gk tanh(kh)，第一模態T=2π/ω=9.177 s；無船且小振幅。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume rectangular tank length 20 m and depth 2 m, with k=π/L and ω²=gk tanh(kh). First-mode T=2π/ω=9.177 s, for small motion without a vessel.
units.verify: 比較槽內不同位置水位相位與船槽加速度頻譜，辨認駐波節點；用有船和無船資料分開驗證，並保留感測器飽和或濺水段。將船體存在與否對應不同的有效自由液面形狀。~Compare level phase at several positions with gondola-acceleration spectra and identify standing-wave nodes. Validate occupied and empty conditions separately, preserving sensor saturation and splash intervals in the record. Relate vessel presence to the resulting change in effective free-surface geometry.
units.failure: 船體遮擋會分割水面並改變模態，大幅晃蕩與撞壁亦超出線性理論。若只取槽中央測站，可能恰好位於節點而錯認沒有晃蕩。~A hull subdivides the free surface and changes modes, while large sloshing and wall impact exceed linear theory. A central sensor may sit near a node and falsely suggest no motion.
units.misconception: 只量船槽中央水位就能可靠捕捉所有晃蕩最大值。~A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response.
units.practice: 以水面晃蕩時間尺度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較槽內不同位置水位相位與船槽加速度頻譜，辨認駐波節點；用有船和無船資料分開驗證，並保留感測器飽和或濺水段。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for free-surface sloshing time scale, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare level phase at several positions with gondola-acceleration spectra and identify standing-wave nodes. Validate occupied and empty conditions separately, preserving sensor saturation and splash intervals in the record.

units.anchor: 運河高差與分段提升~Canal elevation and staged lifting
units.title: 運河高差與分段提升~Canal elevation and staged lifting
units.mechanism: 整個運河連接高差可以由水輪與其他船閘共同完成，不能把整體高差全歸給單一設備。分段能量與水量盤點需要明確界定每個控制體。 假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。 把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。即使單一設備運轉正常，全航路仍可能受到其他節點限制。~A canal-level difference can be shared between a wheel and additional locks. Assigning the entire difference to one device misstates geometry; staged energy and water accounting requires clear control boundaries. Assume total route difference 35 m and wheel portion 24 m, leaving 11 m for other facilities. Only 35 m is official canal context; 24 m is a teaching assumption. Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use. A functioning wheel does not establish availability of the whole route.
units.model: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。~Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total route difference 35 m and wheel portion 24 m, leaving 11 m for other facilities. Only 35 m is official canal context; 24 m is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。逐段核對高程差總和是否回到兩運河實測差。~Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Check definitions of advertised height, structural height and actual lift before using them interchangeably. Check that the sum of stage differences closes against the measured canal-level difference.
units.failure: 把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。即使單一設備運轉正常，全航路仍可能受到其他節點限制。~Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use. A functioning wheel does not establish availability of the whole route.
units.misconception: 官方運河總高差就是水輪單獨完成的精確提升高度。~The official total canal difference is precisely the lift performed by the wheel alone.
units.practice: 以運河高差與分段提升編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。~Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for canal elevation and staged lifting, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Check definitions of advertised height, structural height and actual lift before using them interchangeably.

facts: 官方水輪於2002年開放。~The official wheel opening year is 2002.
官方35 m是兩運河高差，不能直接當水輪單獨提升量。~Official 35 m describes canal-level difference, not necessarily wheel-only lift.
教學水位差0.02 m造成4 t不平衡質量。~Teaching level difference 0.02 m creates imbalance 4 t.
教學半圈300 s、半徑12 m的速度0.12566 m/s。~Teaching half-turn 300 s at radius 12 m gives speed 0.12566 m/s.
教學完整服務能源合計2.1667 kWh，非官方數值。~Teaching full-service energy totals 2.1667 kWh, not an official value.
教學矩形空槽第一晃蕩週期9.177 s。~The teaching empty rectangular tank first sloshing period is 9.177 s.

timeline.event: 福爾柯克水輪開放，取代原先運河連接的船閘階梯功能。~The Falkirk Wheel opens, replacing the former lock-flight connection between the canals.
水工鋼結構設計指引提供輪臂與接頭分析的比較背景。~Hydraulic steel-structure guidance provides comparison context for wheel arms and connections.
機電指引更新供旋轉設備教育參考，並非水輪改建日期。~Updated mechanical guidance supports rotating-equipment education, not a wheel reconstruction date.
